tool_plan.objective: Generate representative Chrome web-cache content and preserve the Chrome Cache_Data source for ChromeCacheView listing, metadata review, export, and file extraction.

required_actions.name: browser.launch
required_actions.why: Starts a Chromium session that creates the Chrome profile cache source.

required_actions.name: browser.goto
required_actions.why: Loads distinct web resources that can populate cache entries and HTTP metadata.

required_actions.name: browser.get_clickables
required_actions.why: Observes visible page controls before exercising content-affecting interactions.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_type
required_actions.why: Performs realistic search input that can produce parameterized cached responses.

required_actions.name: browser.smart_click
required_actions.why: Follows visible links or results to retrieve materially different cacheable content.

required_actions.name: browser.scroll
required_actions.why: Reveals deferred or lazy-loaded resources that may add cache entries.

required_actions.name: browser.screenshot
required_actions.why: Preserves a visible-state representation to correlate with cached content.

required_actions.name: browser.close
required_actions.why: Closes the session so pending browser cache writes can be finalized before collection.

completion.detail: Complete after the Chromium session has been closed and the Chrome Cache_Data artifact is present for collection.

tool_plan.action_intent_guidance: Action Flow: Launch Chromium, then use run-provided runtime resources with browser.goto to load a few relevant, cacheable pages that naturally retrieve varied visible content. On pages with visible search or navigation controls, use browser.get_clickables to identify available controls, browser.smart_type to enter a realistic search or other visible input, and browser.smart_click to open visible results or links that retrieve materially different resources. Use browser.scroll on content-rich pages to reveal deferred resources, then re-run browser.get_clickables where newly visible controls may support additional bounded interaction. Capture browser.screenshot while representative content is visible. Navigate among distinct runtime-provided resources as needed, then browser.close to finalize cache writes. This activity should create Chrome Cache_Data entries for documents, images, scripts, media, and parameterized responses where served cacheably. Reason guidance: write context-specific reasons that state the page activity and expected cache effect, such as loading a resource-rich page to populate cache entries, submitting visible search input to request a parameterized response, op
